parsed.explanation: Parent regime creates real traveler exposure: binary passport policy, visa scrutiny where documents cast doubt on sex with possible fraud consequences, bans in federal facilities, and documented severe abuse in immigration custody if detained. Several measures are litigated or enjoined, reducing certainty but not removing risk. Against this, the division has no documented state facility ban or police targeting, codified gender-identity non-discrimination, explicit hate-crime coverage from 2025, and abolition of the panic defence—traveler-relevant service and recourse protections in force. Resident marker-change and employment rules are only climate signals and were not credited as visitor protections. Unrepealed sodomy statute is a dead letter under national law. Net: materially safer than national average, but federal border/facility exposure keeps it below low-risk tiers.
